name: usora
description: AI-independent, local-first Personal Skill Hub that turns work experience into reusable capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Turn practice into reusable AI capability.
interface.longDescription: Usora collects normalized Activities, discovers Candidates, and helps a configurable Maintainer evaluate and publish evolving Skills in a local, Git-friendly Hub.
